claims: The International Space Station (ISS) is a modular orbiting laboratory.
The International Space Station (ISS) is permanently crewed.
The International Space Station (ISS) functions as a global partnership (USA, Russia, Europe, Japan, Canada).
The ISS orbits Earth every 90 minutes.
The ISS typically accommodates a crew of up to seven astronauts.
The ISS travels at an altitude of approximately 250250250 miles.
The ISS supports hundreds of experiments per crew increment.
